faq-pricing.question: Do credits expire?
faq-pricing.answer: No. Every credit you purchase stays in your account indefinitely. Buy a pack today, use it six months from now — your credits will be waiting.

faq-pricing.question: What counts as one credit?
faq-pricing.answer: One credit equals one AI generation run. A single run produces a complete, production-ready Next.js page or component based on your prompt.

faq-pricing.question: Can I buy multiple packs?
faq-pricing.answer: Absolutely. Credits stack. If you have 30 credits remaining and buy a 100-credit pack, your balance becomes 130.

faq-pricing.question: Is there a free trial?
faq-pricing.answer: Yes — the Free plan gives you 50 credits at no cost, no credit card required. It's the best way to experience the builder before committing.

faq-pricing.question: What payment methods do you accept?
faq-pricing.answer: We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, Mastercard, Amex) via Stripe. All transactions are encrypted and secure.

faq-pricing.question: Can I get a refund?
faq-pricing.answer: If you haven't used any credits from a purchased pack, contact us within 7 days and we'll issue a full refund, no questions asked.

faq-accordion.question: What is Builder by hotcode.ai?
faq-accordion.answer: Builder is an AI-powered website generator that turns a plain-English description of your site into a fully functional, production-ready Next.js codebase in under 60 seconds. No design skills or coding experience required.

faq-accordion.question: How does the AI generate my website?
faq-accordion.answer: You describe your site in natural language — your industry, style preferences, and key pages. Our AI (powered by GPT-4o) interprets your prompt, generates clean TypeScript + Next.js code, applies Tailwind CSS styling, and renders a live preview you can explore instantly.

faq-accordion.question: What technology stack does the generated code use?
faq-accordion.answer: Every site is generated with Next.js 14 (App Router), TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS — the same stack used by top engineering teams. The output is clean, readable, and ready to deploy to Vercel, Netlify, or any Node-compatible host.

faq-accordion.question: Can I export and own the code?
faq-accordion.answer: Absolutely. With any paid credit pack, you can export the full source code as a ZIP file. The code is yours — no lock-in, no runtime dependency on Builder. Deploy it anywhere you like.

faq-accordion.question: What are credits and how do they work?
faq-accordion.answer: Credits are the currency for generating sites. Each generation consumes credits based on complexity. You start with 50 free credits, and you can purchase additional packs (100, 250, or 500 credits) at any time. Credits never expire.

faq-accordion.question: Is there a free plan?
faq-accordion.answer: Yes. Every new account receives 50 free credits — enough to generate and preview several websites. No credit card required to get started.

faq-accordion.question: How long does it take to generate a website?
faq-accordion.answer: Most sites are generated in under 60 seconds. Complex multi-page sites with custom components may take up to 90 seconds. You'll see a live progress indicator while the AI builds your site.

faq-accordion.question: Can I edit the generated site after it's created?
faq-accordion.answer: Yes. You can re-prompt the AI to iterate on any section, or export the code and edit it directly in your preferred code editor. Builder is designed to be a starting point, not a cage.

faq-accordion.question: Does Builder support full-stack features like databases or APIs?
faq-accordion.answer: Builder generates full-stack Next.js projects including API routes and server components. For database connections, you'll add your own environment variables and ORM configuration post-export — Builder sets up the scaffolding and patterns.

faq-accordion.question: What happens if I'm not happy with the generated result?
faq-accordion.answer: You can regenerate with a refined prompt at any time. We also recommend adding more detail to your initial description — the more specific you are, the better the output. Regenerations consume credits, but our team is always available to help you craft a great prompt.

faq-accordion.question: Is my data and generated code kept private?
faq-accordion.answer: Yes. Your prompts and generated projects are private to your account. We do not use your project data to train AI models. You can delete your projects and account data at any time from your settings.

faq-accordion.question: How do I deploy my generated website?
faq-accordion.answer: After exporting your code, you can deploy to Vercel with a single `vercel deploy` command, push to GitHub and connect to Netlify, or run `npm run build && npm start` on any server. Our documentation includes step-by-step deployment guides.

faq-accordion.question: Can I use Builder for client projects?
faq-accordion.answer: Yes. There are no restrictions on commercial use. Many freelancers and agencies use Builder to rapidly prototype and deliver client websites. The exported code is fully licensable for commercial projects.

faq-accordion.question: Do you offer refunds?
faq-accordion.answer: Credit packs are non-refundable once credits have been used. If you experience a technical issue that prevents generation, contact our support team and we'll make it right with a credit top-up.

faq-accordion.question: How do I contact support?
faq-accordion.answer: You can reach us via the Contact page, or email us directly at support@hotcode.ai. We typically respond within one business day.
